description: Token used by the negative auth scenario. NOTE: the QA API (as-rc-test-api) reads the user from the JWT payload but does NOT validate signature or expiry - a genuinely expired or signature-tampered B2C token still returns 200. Only a malformed (non-parseable) token yields 401, so this holds a deliberately invalid string to make the 'expired token -> 401 -> refresh -> 200' flow work.
